```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
```

# Inputs

```{r}
file_samples <- "../data/proteom_rmb1_slc6a8_ko_aza_tcell/data/proteomics_sample_list.xlsx"
file_prot    <- "../data/proteom_rmb1_slc6a8_ko_aza_tcell/data/proteoflux_table.xlsx"
out_dir      <- "../results/figures/proteomics"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

```

# Sample sheet

```{r}
grp_map <- tibble(
  Group       = 1:4,
  pf_group    = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
  group_key   = c("CTRL_VEH", "KO_VEH", "CTRL_AZA_Tcells", "KO_AZA_Tcells"),
  group_label = c("CTRL,Vehicle", "KO,Vehicle", "CTRL,AZA+Tcells", "KO,AZA+Tcells")
)

samp <- read_excel(file_samples) %>%
  rename(vial = `Number on vial`, cell_type = `cell type`) %>%
  mutate(
    vial        = as.integer(vial),
    Group       = as.integer(Group),
    Description = trimws(Description),
    sample_id   = sprintf("%03d_TG002FT_J26", vial)
  ) %>%
  left_join(grp_map, by = "Group")

samp %>% count(Group, pf_group, Description, group_label)
```

# Proteomics (ProteoFlux 'Summary' sheet)

```{r}
prot <- read_excel(file_prot, sheet = "Summary", guess_max = 10000)

int_cols <- paste0("Processed_log2_Intensities", samp$sample_id)
raw_cols <- paste0("Raw_Intensities", samp$sample_id)

stopifnot(all(int_cols %in% colnames(prot)), all(raw_cols %in% colnames(prot)))
dim(prot)
```

# Heatmap — AZA + T cells (CTRL vs KO)

## Genes and samples

```{r}
genes_hm <- c("Cybb", "Cd40", "Cd80", "Cd86", "S100a9", "H2-DMa", "H2-DMb1", "H2-Aa", "H2-Ab1", "H2-Ea", "Cd74")

prot_map <- prot %>%
  select(UNIPROT_AC, GENE_NAMES, NUM_PRECURSORS, NUM_UNIQUE_PEPTIDES) %>%
  mutate(gene = GENE_NAMES) %>%
  separate_rows(gene, sep = ";") %>%
  filter(gene %in% genes_hm) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  slice_max(NUM_PRECURSORS, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

missing_genes <- setdiff(genes_hm, prot_map$gene)
if (length(missing_genes) > 0)
  message("Not found in data (dropped): ", paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "))

prot_map <- prot_map %>% slice(match(intersect(genes_hm, gene), gene))
prot_map

grp_levels_hm <- c("CTRL,AZA+Tcells", "KO,AZA+Tcells")

samp_ord <- samp %>%
  filter(group_label %in% grp_levels_hm) %>%
  mutate(group_label = factor(group_label, levels = grp_levels_hm)) %>%
  arrange(group_label, vial)
```

## Matrices and stats

```{r}
prot_sel <- prot %>% slice(match(prot_map$UNIPROT_AC, UNIPROT_AC))

mat <- prot_sel %>%
  select(all_of(paste0("Processed_log2_Intensities", samp_ord$sample_id))) %>%
  as.matrix()
dimnames(mat) <- list(prot_map$gene, samp_ord$sample_id)

imp_mat <- prot_sel %>%
  select(all_of(paste0("Raw_Intensities", samp_ord$sample_id))) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  is.na()
dimnames(imp_mat) <- dimnames(mat)

keep    <- apply(mat, 1, sd) > 0
mat     <- mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
imp_mat <- imp_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
mat_z   <- t(scale(t(mat)))

st_aza <- prot_sel %>%
  transmute(gene  = prot_map$gene,
            logFC = -log2FC_C_vs_D,
            FDR   = QVALUE_C_vs_D,
            n_obs_CTRL = Observed_C,
            n_obs_KO   = Observed_D) %>%
  slice(match(rownames(mat_z), gene))

st_aza
```

## Plot

```{r, fig.width = 5.5, fig.height = 4.6}
mark_imputed <- TRUE
show_ns      <- TRUE

sig_lab <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "",
  ifelse(p < 0.001, "***",
  ifelse(p < 0.01,  "**",
  ifelse(p < 0.05,   "*", if (show_ns) "ns" else ""))))
}

grp_cols <- c("CTRL,AZA+Tcells" = "#FCBBA1", "KO,AZA+Tcells" = "#CB181D")

z_lim   <- max(abs(mat_z), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-z_lim, 0, z_lim), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))

m            <- max(abs(st_aza$logFC), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun_stat <- colorRamp2(c(-m, 0, m), c("#2166AC", "white", "#D6604D"))

top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = samp_ord$group_label,
  col   = list(Group = grp_cols),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    Group = list(title = "Group",
                 title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
                 labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12))
  )
)

row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  `AZA+Tc` = anno_simple(st_aza$logFC, col = col_fun_stat,
                         pch = sig_lab(st_aza$FDR),
                         pt_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
                         na_col = "grey90", width = unit(8, "mm")),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

stat_legend <- Legend(
  col_fun   = col_fun_stat,
  title     = "log2FC\n(KO vs CTRL)",
  direction = "vertical",
  title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)
)

imp_legend <- Legend(
  labels    = "Not detected\n(imputed)",
  type      = "points", pch = 4,
  legend_gp = gpar(col = "grey30"),
  background = "white",
  title     = NULL,
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)
)

lgd_list <- if (mark_imputed && any(imp_mat)) list(stat_legend, imp_legend) else list(stat_legend)

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_z,
  name                = "Row z-score\n(log2 intensity)",
  col                 = col_fun,
  top_annotation      = top_anno,
  right_annotation    = row_anno,
  cluster_rows        = FALSE,
  cluster_columns     = FALSE,
  column_split        = samp_ord$group_label,
  column_title        = NULL,
  show_column_names   = FALSE,
  row_names_side      = "left",
  row_names_gp        = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "italic"),
  column_gap          = unit(1.5, "mm"),
  border              = TRUE,
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (mark_imputed && imp_mat[i, j])
      grid.points(x, y, pch = 4, size = unit(2, "mm"), gp = gpar(col = "grey30", lwd = 1))
  },
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)
  )
)

draw_ht <- function() {
  draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE,
       heatmap_legend_side    = "right",
       annotation_legend_side = "right",
       annotation_legend_list = lgd_list,
       padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "mm"),
       ht_gap  = unit(8, "mm"))
}

draw_ht()
```

## Save + log

```{r}
file_hm_prot <- "heatmap_proteomics_costim_MHCII_AZA_Tcells.pdf"
pdf(file.path(out_dir, file_hm_prot), width = 5.5, height = 4.6)
draw_ht()
dev.off()
```
